info.description:
The course consists of 12 chapters. In one chapter are 2 reading passages
with the same theme, presented in 6 parts: 
Before
you read, reading skill, reading comprehension, critical thinking, vocabulary
comprehension 
and
 vocabulary skill
.
The aim of the course is to provide students with pre-intermediate level
language as well as social and natural knowledge regarding to such fields as
food, education, sports, finance, society, language, and festivals. Through the
reading practice during the course, students are also equipped themselves with
reading skills as follows:

-
Skimming
-
Scanning
-
Predicting

-
Understanding inferences
